title: Find Polygon With the Largest Perimeter
sourceKind: search summaries of the LeetCode statement and mirrors (leetcode.com page cited; not fetched directly, 403 for direct fetch)
summary: Given positive integers nums, pick at least three of them that form a polygon (longest side strictly less than the sum of the others). Return the largest perimeter, or -1 if none exists.
visualizationNotes: Visualization accepts 3 to 50 sides; perimeter values stay within JSON number range.
